title: Task Force Arkansas Aids During Hurricane Harvey Aftermath
description:
The Arkansas National Guard has deployed nearly 1,500 Soldiers and Airmen to disaster stricken Texas. One of the many missions of the Arkansas Guardsmen is to provide manpower and logistical support at relief depots.

This video shows members of Task Force Aleutian, a smaller element of Task Force Arkansas, passing out essential household items to include food and water.

(U.S. Army National Guard video by Spc. Stephen M. Wright)

transcript.text: - [Narrator] Overall, the Arkansas National Guard
has deployed nearly 1500 soldiers and airmen
to disaster-stricken Texas.
One of their many missions
is to provide manpower and logistical support
to relief depots.
We stopped by one of those depots
where we ran into a group of Arkansans
from Task Force Aleutians,
a smaller element within Task Force Arkansas,
to get an up-close look at the relief efforts
and distribution process.
- We are helping out the community.
It's a lot of people who lost,
a lot of people lost a lot of their homes,
they lost supplies.
So a lot of people who are
cleaning up their homes right now.
So we came here to the distribution center,
we're handing out tithing kits,
we're handing out food, water,
supplies to clean up their house,
toys for the kids, food, MREs.
Trucks have come in, civilians have brought in stuff.
We're unloading it, we're storing it in the warehouse
and distributing it throughout
20 of the counties around this area.
We are gonna stay here until we're no longer needed.
So my numbers that I do,
I make sure I write down everything,
every car that comes in, every family that comes in,
how much MREs we're giving out,
how much food we're giving out, what they're in need of.
I crunched some numbers today,
and from eight o'clock this morning
to about two o'clock this afternoon,
we have passed out 27'000 cases of MREs,
and we passed out over 1600 cases of water.
Texas has done really good,
coming together, helping each other out,
helping the community out,
and you never know what you have
until you don't have anything at all.
- [Narrator] For the Arkansas National Guard,
in Kountze, Texas, I'm Specialist Stephen Wright.
